text: A bird escaped its cage... without breaking a single bar.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: A merchant heads to India. His caged parrot says... tell the wild parrots I'm locked in here.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He does... On hearing it, one of them at once fell down dead.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Back home, his parrot hears this... and drops. Thrown out... it flies to a branch. Alive.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The wild parrot had only feigned death... to suggest this way of escaping from confinement in a cage.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In Rumi's full verse, the message was... your sweet voice keeps you caged.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The gift that wins you praise... can become your cage.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The top student who never risks a wrong answer. The joker who can't say he's hurt.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Freedom isn't smashing bars. It's dropping the performance.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Today, do one thing nobody will clap for... just to grow.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What were you praised into? One word, in the comments.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz for tomorrow morning's lesson.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
